# Loading libraries

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(readxl)
```


# 2.12 Keystone exercise: Estuary Fish Survey - Data Rescue Mission


# Importing the files
```{r}

#estuary catch log data
#the excel workbook has different tabs 
#need to be loaded individually
catch1 <- read_excel(here::here("data/estuary_catch_log.xlsx"), sheet = "Lower_ross")
catch2 <- read_excel("../data/estuary_catch_log.xlsx", sheet = 2)
catch3 <- read_excel("../data/estuary_catch_log.xlsx", sheet = 3)
catch4 <- read_excel("../data/estuary_catch_log.xlsx", sheet = 4)  

#estuary metadata file
metadata <- read.csv(here::here("data/estuary_metadata.csv")) 
  
#estuary sonde data file

  
#species dictionary file
species_dict <- 
read.csv(here::here("data/species_dictionary.csv"))
```


# Inspecting the indiviual tabs

Look at anomalies between the workbooks and variable names if they do not align

The column titles are consistent but the variable names are not consistent across the different tabs.
```{r inspect-catch-tabs}
catch1
catch2
catch3
catch4

```


# Combining all the different tabs in the catch log excel 

Binding the rows

```{r bind-catch}
catch_data <- bind_rows(catch1, catch2, catch3, catch4)
# Clean up the environment
rm(catch1, catch2, catch3, catch4) # Clean up the environment
```


# Preliminary checks

```{r inspect-catch}
catch_data
head(catch_data)
glimpse(catch_data)
str(catch_data)

```


Using distinct() to check for unique values in the columns to see if there are any anomalies in the data and if need to clean before converting to factor variables
  
    - the species names and sites are not consistent across the different tabs. The species and site names have different capitalisation. 
    - need to be cleaned before joining with the species dictionary and estuary metadata files.
    
    
```{r distinct-catch}
catch_data |> 
  distinct(site)

catch_data |> 
  distinct(species)

```

# Checking metadata file

    - Site names also need to be cleaned before joining with the catch data file.
    
```{r inspect-metadata}
head(metadata)
glimpse(metadata)
```



# Fixing site names in the catch data file + converting to factor variables

```{r fix-site-names}
catch_data <- catch_data |>
  mutate(
    site = str_to_lower(str_trim(site)),
    site = str_replace_all(site, " ", "_")) |> 
  # Convert all chr to fct
  mutate(across(where(is.character), as_factor)
  )

metadata <- metadata |>
  mutate(
    site_name = str_to_lower(str_trim(site_name)),
    site_name = str_replace_all(site_name, " ", "_")) |> 
  # Convert all chr to fct
  mutate(across(where(is.character), as_factor)
  )

```

- checking if the site names have been fixed
